evidence: Their weakness is not that it's a prototype; it's that the evaluation surface is fabricated.
metric: 25 files, ~8,000 lines, 1 commit, 0 tests; 0.934 AUROC; 1,240 nodes / 4,850 triples; +0.012, -0.068; 4 of 5 PMIDs unrelated
observation: A code-level audit of the shared BioKG-Agentic-App found 25 files and roughly 8,000 lines with one commit, no tests and no database driver; the five-stage pipeline is a single Gemini prompt that returns JSON nodes and edges. Benchmark metrics are hardcoded profiles (for example 0.934 AUROC, 1,240 nodes, 4,850 triples) and the sliders add fixed deltas such as +0.012 for RGCN and -0.068 without the gene/protein spine, so no model scores anything. Four of five sampled PMIDs cited as provenance resolve to unrelated papers.
subject: F-1
title: Competitor BioKG prototype's benchmark numbers are hardcoded
